fonts.role: Hangul display — the giant 꿈, section titles, bedtime lines; a soft rounded serif that reads you to sleep
all other Hangul and Korean body text — round and calm, the page at rest
every Latin mark — the DREAM wordmark, numerals, kickers, English body; a round geometric sans that never raises its voice

texture: Two SVG feTurbulence fields, both decorative-only and aria-hidden. (1) A full-sky dream haze: feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.012 0.018, numOctaves 2, fed through feColorMatrix to a soft lavender-grey alpha, blended over the page at ~12% — the veil of a closing eye, drifting via feOffset every 24s. (2) A finer grain (baseFrequency 0.9 0.9, numOctaves 1, fractalNoise) at ~6% opacity for the cloud puffs themselves, so no cloud reads as a flat CSS blob. Under reduced motion both hold one composed still frame.

motion.name: ease-drift
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.84, 0.28, 1) — slow to start, slower to settle, like something weightless

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 1100ms ease-drift, translateY(18px) → 0, 90ms stagger per observer batch

motion.name: parallax lerp
motion.value: 0.045 per 60fps-normalized frame toward the pointer — slower than SUP on purpose; clouds don't chase

motion.name: cloud far
motion.value: translate factor × 6px / 4px at full deflection — the back sky barely moves

motion.name: cloud mid
motion.value: translate factor × 16px / 10px — the middle layer carries the weightless drift

motion.name: cloud near
motion.value: translate factor × 30px / 18px — the nearest puff reads as arm's length

motion.name: haze breath
motion.value: feOffset 0 → 60 over 24s ease-in-out alternate — the dream haze drifts across the sky

motion.name: descent scrub
motion.value: lerp 0.08/frame toward scroll progress 0→1; sky color cloud → mist → indigo via 4-stop lerp, cloud opacity 1 → 0.18, star opacity 0 → 0.9

motion.name: descent span
motion.value: pinned section is 220vh tall; progress maps the inner 220vh minus 100vh to the 0→1 clock

motion.name: cloud bob
motion.value: ambient float ±6px Y, mutually prime periods 13s / 17s / 23s / 29s — the sky never visibly loops

motion.name: grain shift
motion.value: cloud-grain turbulence seed lerps 0→1 over 37s, then rests — a slow respiring texture
